sous_titre: Encours net des fonds UCITS et AIF en Europe, en milliers de milliards d'euros, fin de période

Fin 2024.texte: In 2024, net assets increased by 13% to a new record of EUR 23.4 tn.

Fin 2025.texte: Combined net assets of UCITS and AIFs increased by 7.7% in 2025, ending the year at EUR 25.2 trillion.

Fin juin 2026.texte: Net assets of UCITS and AIFs increased by 8.4% in Q2 2026, reaching EUR 27.51 trillion.
